title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
title_zh: HINT-WAM：利用示范未来信息训练世界动作模型
abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) have shown promising generalization and data efficiency in robot manipulation by coupling action generation with predictions of future visual dynamics. Translating these capabilities into reliable task execution, however, remains a challenge for existing post-training methods. Offline supervised fine-tuning provides dense supervision on expert trajectories, but its flow-matching action expert is trained only on noised demonstration actions and never on the intermediate states produced by its own sampler; task-specific adaptation can also compromise pretrained capabilities. On-policy reinforcement learning trains on the policy's own behavior, yet sparse task rewards make exploration and credit assignment difficult, while dense reward shaping still provides scalar evaluations rather than direct action targets. We introduce HINT-WAM, the first on-policy self-distillation framework that supervises the action expert on its own sampling trajectories using hindsight, the future video of the demonstration, as privileged information available to the WAM itself. For each demonstration observation, the student generates its action through its own denoising trajectory, and at the states along this trajectory the same model acts as a teacher conditioned additionally on this hindsight, providing a conditional action distribution as a dense training target, while the student sees only deployment-time inputs and needs no environmental rewards or simulator interaction. To transfer this supervision to a flow-matching action expert, HINT-WAM distills the teacher into the student with an energy score, a distribution-level objective that matches the teacher's action distribution from the student's own samples rather than regressing its velocity field. The project web is available in https://tuandattt.github.io/hintwam/.
abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（World Action Models，WAMs）将动作生成与未来视觉动态预测相结合，在机器人操作中展现出良好的泛化潜力和数据效率，但现有后训练方法仍难以将这些优势转化为可靠的任务执行。离线监督微调虽能利用专家轨迹提供密集监督，却只在加噪后的示范动作上训练流匹配（flow matching）动作专家，不覆盖模型自身采样产生的中间状态；面向特定任务的适配也可能损害预训练能力。在策略强化学习能基于策略自身的行为训练，但稀疏奖励使探索和信用分配变得困难，即使采用密集奖励塑形，也只能提供标量评价，而非直接的动作目标。HINT-WAM 提出一种在策略自蒸馏框架：对于每个示范观测，学生沿自身的去噪轨迹生成动作；在这条轨迹的中间状态上，同一模型额外以示范的未来视频为条件，作为教师提供条件动作分布，形成密集监督。学生只接收部署时可用的输入，无需环境奖励或模拟器交互。蒸馏采用能量评分（energy score），用学生自身生成的样本匹配教师的动作分布，而不是回归教师的速度场。
key_points_zh: 区别于只在加噪示范动作上训练的离线监督微调，HINT-WAM 直接监督学生自身去噪轨迹上的中间状态。
教师与学生由同一模型充当：教师额外看到示范的未来视频，学生只接收部署时可用的输入。
在策略监督来自模型自身的动作采样轨迹，而非环境交互；训练不需要环境奖励或模拟器。
能量评分（energy score）利用学生样本匹配教师的条件动作分布，不直接回归教师的速度场。
